items.title: Govt refers FCRA Amendment Bill to JPC as Parliament deadlock continues; Oppn says, ‘scrap the bill’
items.summary: The Central Government is expected to move a motion in Parliament today to refer the Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Act (FCRA) Amendment Bill to a Joint Parliamentary Committee (JPC), sources said on Wednesday.

items.title: Compromised PM forced to sell India’s interest: Rahul Gandhi as US court drops charges against Adani
items.summary: On Monday, a United States federal judge formally dismissed criminal charges in a securities fraud case against the billionaire.

items.title: Kolkata doctor’s rape, murder: Ex-TMC MLA among three named in fresh FIR about ‘hasty’ cremation
items.summary: The case was registered after West Bengal CM Suvendu Adhikari directed the police to investigate the matter.

items.title: Parliament Monsoon Session: What to expect in final 2 days as deadlock continues. Will Amit Shah speak?
items.summary: The Rajya Sabha passed the Tribunals Reforms Bill, 2026 after a brief debate while bills in Lok Sabha continued to be passed without discussion amid opposition sloganeering.

items.title: SC declines to interfere with Calcutta HC order denying TMC access to bank accounts frozen by ED
items.summary: The case pertains to alleged financial irregularities, unlawful collection of money and routing of suspected funds through Trinamool Congress bank accounts.

items.title: Amit Shah is a ‘coward’ for not attending Parliament, says Congress
items.summary: Union minister Kiren Rijiju said that the government was ready for ‘detailed discussion’, and accused Rahul Gandhi of ‘running away’ and shouting slogans.

items.title: Question of faith: Vijay faces secularism test over Speaker’s abortion stand, minister’s Bible remark
items.summary: The TVK government is scrambling to contain a controversy over faith after its Speaker endorsed an anti-abortion rally and its finance minister said Christianity taught him love and compassion.

items.title: Bill criminalising insults to ‘Vande Mataram’ becomes law after President Murmu’s assent
items.summary: Intentionally preventing the singing of the song or disrupting an assembly singing it can be punished with imprisonment of up to three years, the law states.

items.title: One protest, two positions: Congress’ tightrope in Jharkhand—back the students, stay in govt
items.summary: Rahul Gandhi and Sam Pitroda have backed Jharkhand’s protesting students, but Congress’ four ministers remain in the Soren government—exposing the limits of opposition from within power.

items.title: Tamil Nadu Assembly passes resolution seeking abolition of NEET
items.summary: The move came amid an ongoing anti-NEET hunger strike in Chennai, which entered its 11th day on Tuesday.

items.title: Jharkhand: ABVP workers detained after clash with police during march to Assembly
items.summary: The Bharatiya Janata Party called for a statewide bandh until midnight on Tuesday to protest the use of lathis and tear gas against youth demonstrators.

items.title: Sexual harassment allegations against Brij Bhushan were ‘politically motivated’: Delhi court
items.summary: The wrestlers’ accusations against the BJP leader appeared to be rehearsed, well-practised and planted, the bench had further said in its August 3 order.

items.title: Bengal SIR: SC says it cannot set timeline for tribunals hearing appeals against voter deletions
items.summary: The Supreme Court, however, sought details from the Election Commission on pending and disposed cases before the appellate tribunals.

items.title: Centre introduces bill in Lok Sabha to restrict states from imposing taxes on mineral rights
items.summary: The bill, introduced by Union minister G Kishan Reddy on Monday, also seeks to empower the Union government to regulate mineral-bearing lands.
